## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature (algorithm / dataset / visualization)
- [ ] Performance / bundle size
- [ ] Docs / tooling
- [ ] Refactor (no behavior change)

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm run test` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds and `npm run size:check` is within budget
- [ ] If I added/removed an algorithm, dataset, or visual family, I updated the
      counts everywhere (the `meta-consistency` test enforces this)
- [ ] I considered accessibility (keyboard, screen-reader, focus) for any UI
